channel.title: The Grant Desk - UK, next 90 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: UK, next 90 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
